intro: Illustrations of the places and moments this site is about, and a few short explainer videos made for the project.

pictures.title: Everest at dawn
pictures.caption: The summit pyramid catching the first light.

pictures.caption: Weather turns quickly in the Karakoram.

pictures.title: A pyramid peak in clear weather
pictures.caption: A rope team heading for the summit ridge.

pictures.title: Aconcagua at dusk
pictures.caption: The highest peak in the Andes.

pictures.title: Kilimanjaro at sunrise
pictures.caption: A mountain you can climb without technical skills.

pictures.title: Climbers on the summit ridge
pictures.caption: Roped together on the last stretch.

pictures.title: Ice climbing
pictures.caption: Two tools, two crampons, and a lot of calf muscle.

pictures.title: Crossing a glacier
pictures.caption: A rope team steps around a crevasse.

pictures.title: Mountain hut at night
pictures.caption: Warm light in a cold valley.

pictures.title: Prayer flags
pictures.caption: Flags strung above a Himalayan valley.

pictures.title: An old-style engraving
pictures.caption: Early climbers drew the Alps like this.

videos.title: How thin does the air get?
videos.text: A 15 second look at how much oxygen is available at different heights, from sea level to the top of Everest.

videos.title: Everest South Col route
videos.text: The camps on the standard Nepal-side route and the height of each, from Base Camp to the summit.

videos.title: The Seven Summits
videos.text: The highest peak on each continent, drawn to scale against each other.
